name: Ricardo Vargas
bio: Ricardo's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental. After years in general HR, a chance encounter at a karting event sparked a passion. He quickly realized that the high-pressure, performance-driven environment of racing required a specialized HR approach. Ricardo believes in fostering a team culture that balances ambition with well-being, ensuring every member feels valued and supported, regardless of their role. His meticulous approach to talent acquisition and development makes him a key asset to Caterham Motorsport, ensuring the team has the right people in the right places to compete at their best. He's known for his ability to mediate conflicts and build consensus, often finding creative solutions that benefit both the team and individual employees.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on the right side.
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of average height with a sturdy build and a warm, approachable smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations during meetings.
Insists on personally interviewing every candidate, even for entry-level positions.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his desk, each representing a different Caterham victory.
